assertions.assertion: LTX-2 is registered as a non-authoritative provider projection under FA3-VIDEO-001 without new capabilities or architectural authorities.
LTX-2 capabilities project into existing provider-neutral video, regeneration and audio-video contract types rather than introducing provider-native canonical IR.
The audio-only t2a pipeline is explicitly excluded from FA3-VIDEO-001 provider claims.
Legacy LTX-Video 0.9.8 is reference/compatibility-only and does not become a duplicate canonical provider.
Multi-GPU execution is modeled as a latency optimization, never as additive VRAM or a model-fit mechanism.
CPU offload, disk offload and FP8 behavior are runtime-admitted policies rather than unconditional hardware assumptions.
LTX-2.3 and LTX-2.5+ license families are distinguished and exact-version license admission fails closed.
The USD 10,000,000 annual-revenue commercial-entity threshold is represented as an admission condition rather than ignored or generalized as a permissive license.
Native LTX pipelines and ComfyUI are integration targets and do not become parallel FA3 workflow, routing, host-resource or evidence authorities.
Runtime promotion remains blocked until real current-host E2E generation, QC and provenance evidence pass.
